activity_summary: It was thou on the stair, the first sit-down at Blackfriars since Whitsun. Field asked for his Holinshed, the second volume, and you told him a cat keeps it. He said that is not what a book is for. Jacqueline asked after your wife as one householder after another, and did not translate the pottage. You gave the streets. When the great house by the chapel went by, he looked up and did not ask.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat down, left the book with the cat, and told the streets.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Asked for the second volume, took the streets, and did not ask about the house.

entities.name: Jacqueline Field
entities.context: Set a pottage with a French name on the table, and asked after his wife.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported well, and not at the table.

entities.name: Holinshed
entities.context: Mentioned in Thou on the stair

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: My Holinshed, Will. The second volume. I see the gap every morning.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It's safe. A cat keeps it.

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: That is not what a book is for.
